description: LUNOVA CLOUDER unites three engineering minds from Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Information Engineering Technology with one mission: keeping astronauts healthy far from Earth. We are building an AI-powered health monitoring system that tracks vital signs in real time, predicts risks before they become emergencies and guides crews with clear alerts. We bring AI/ML, full-stack development and sensor expertise. Seeking a UI/UX designer and storyteller to join our crew.
